rows.label: qst200205_msg0003
rows.name:
Grumbling isn't going to
solve anything. Come on,
explain to me what happened!

rows.label: qst200205_msg0004
rows.name:
[ML:Dash ]You've got honest eyes.
Harhal used to look like that too[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200205_msg0005
rows.name:
I love dancing, so I came to Avaritia
to make my dream come true.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0006
rows.name:
Harhal had the same dream, so
we became friends right away.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0007
rows.name: [ML:Dash ]So you really were best friends.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0008
rows.name:
Yes. We were always together, and
we could tell each other anything.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0009
rows.name:
But her talent was the real thing.
I wasn't even in her league.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0010
rows.name:
She was always the one shining,
and I could only stand in her shadow.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0037
rows.name:
She was Chairman Bahn's favorite.
I was practically an afterthought[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200205_msg0011
rows.name:
Being Chairman Bahn's favorite
meant better pay, of course.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0012
rows.name:
She got excellent treatment.
I was treated pretty well too.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0013
rows.name:
But, Chairman Bahn lost
his position, didn't he?

rows.label: qst200205_msg0014
rows.name:
If we wanted to keep dancing,
we had to work at diners and bars
like this.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0015
rows.name:
However, I was satisfied.
I could continue the dancing
I loved anywhere.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0016
rows.name:
We couldn't live luxuriously anymore,
but as long as I was with Harhal,
it was just as much fun.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0017
rows.name:
But[ML:Dash ]
it seems Harhal didn't feel the same.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0018
rows.name:
She immediately started complaining,
said she was quitting dance, and
ran away from Avaritia[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200205_msg0019
rows.name: Why was Harhal dissatisfied?

rows.label: qst200205_msg0020
rows.name:
Who knows? I'm already sick
of thinking about that girl.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0021
rows.name:
[ML:Dash ]Then, do you know where Harhal
went? We are searching for her.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0022
rows.name:
She said she was returning to her
parents' home in Alba Margen, but[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200205_msg0023
rows.name:
Superbia[ML:Dash ]
Let's try there next.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0024
rows.name: Hey, Couche.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0025
rows.name: You're still dancing, right?

rows.label: qst200205_msg0026
rows.name: Technically, yes[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200205_msg0027
rows.name:
Your passion for dancing and the way
you care about your friend are real.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0028
rows.name:
So, if Harhal returns, will
you welcome her one more time?

rows.label: qst200205_msg0029
rows.name:
[ML:Dash ]Talking with you helped me sort
out my feelings a little.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0030
rows.name:
I want to dance with Harhal
again too.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0031
rows.name: So, I'll give her one more chance.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0032
rows.name: That's what best friends do.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0033
rows.name: Heheh. Take care of Harhal for me.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0034
rows.name:
If she's still serious about dancing,
bring her here.

rows.label: qst200205_msg0035
rows.name:
Harhal was Bahn's favorite, a great
dancer, and everyone fawned over her[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200205_msg0036
rows.name:
In the end, she betrayed me and
disappeared! I don't know anything
about a girl like that!
